mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_CONTENT_RECORD_ITEM_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS (RECORD_ITEM_ID,RECORD_TARGET_ID,RECORD_TYPE,CONTENT_ID,TITLE,SORT_ORDER,CREATED_BY) VALUES (#{recordItemId},#{recordTargetId},#{recordType},#{contentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR},NVL(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=NUMERIC},1),#{createdBy})

SELECT SEQ_NOTE_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO NOTES (NOTE_ID,FOLDER_ID,SCOPE_TYPE,WS_ID,PROJ_ID,USER_ID,NOTE_TITLE,MEMO,CATEGORY,REG_DT,UPDATED_BY,DELETED_YN) SELECT #{contentId},t.NOTE_FOLDER_ID, CASE WHEN t.SCOPE_TYPE='PERSONAL' THEN 'PRIVATE' WHEN t.SCOPE_TYPE='GROUP' THEN 'WS' ELSE 'PROJ' END, t.WS_ID,t.PROJ_ID,#{createdBy},NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(#{title}),''),'새 노트'),#{previewContent,jdbcType=CLOB},'TASK_RECORD',SYSDATE,#{createdBy},'N' FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t WHERE t.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTES n SET n.NOTE_TITLE=NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(#{title}),''),SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{content},'[[:space:]]+',' '),1,30)), n.MEMO=#{content,jdbcType=CLOB},n.UPD_DT=SYSDATE,n.UPDATED_BY=#{userId} WHERE n.NOTE_ID=(SELECT i.CONTENT_ID FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i WHERE i.RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE='NOTE' AND i.DELETED_YN='N') AND NVL(n.NOTE_TITLE, CHR(0)) = NVL(#{baseTitle,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CHR(0)) AND ( (n.MEMO IS NULL AND #{baseContent,jdbcType=CLOB} IS NULL) OR (n.MEMO IS NOT NULL AND #{baseContent,jdbcType=CLOB} IS NOT NULL AND DBMS_LOB.COMPARE(n.MEMO, #{baseContent,jdbcType=CLOB}) = 0) )

UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET TITLE=#{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND RECORD_TYPE='NOTE' AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET DELETED_YN='Y',UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND RECORD_TYPE='NOTE' AND DELETED_YN='N'

UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET TITLE=#{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND RECORD_TYPE='LINK' AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET DELETED_YN='Y',UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND RECORD_TYPE='LINK' AND DELETED_YN='N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i JOIN CONTENT_RECORD_LINKS l ON l.RECORD_ITEM_ID=i.RECORD_ITEM_ID WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE='LINK' AND i.DELETED_YN='N' AND LOWER(TRIM(l.LINK_URL))=LOWER(TRIM(#{linkUrl})) AND i.RECORD_ITEM_ID<>#{excludeRecordItemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_LOCATIONS p SET p.LOCATION_TEXT=#{locationText,jdbcType=VARCHAR},p.LOCATION_ADDRESS=#{locationAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, p.LOCATION_LAT=#{locationLat,jdbcType=NUMERIC},p.LOCATION_LNG=#{locationLng,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, p.LOCATION_PLACE_ID=#{locationPlaceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},p.MEMO=#{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, p.DESCRIPTION=#{locationDescription,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE p.RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i WHERE i.RECORD_ITEM_ID=p.RECORD_ITEM_ID AND i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE='LOCATION' AND i.DELETED_YN='N')

UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET TITLE=#{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR},UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND RECORD_TYPE='LOCATION' AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET DELETED_YN='Y',UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND RECORD_TYPE='LOCATION' AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET DELETED_YN='Y',UPDATED_AT=SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND RECORD_TYPE='FILE' AND DELETED_YN='N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_TYPE='FILE' AND CONTENT_ID=#{contentFileId} AND DELETED_YN='N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_TYPE='LOCATION' AND DELETED_YN='N'
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_LOCATIONS p SET p.PRIMARY_YN='N' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i WHERE i.RECORD_ITEM_ID=p.RECORD_ITEM_ID AND i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE='LOCATION' AND i.DELETED_YN='N')
mapper.select: SELECT RECORD_ITEM_ID FROM ( SELECT i.RECORD_ITEM_ID FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE='LOCATION' AND i.DELETED_YN='N' ORDER BY i.SORT_ORDER,i.RECORD_ITEM_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM=1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i JOIN CONTENT_RECORD_LOCATIONS p ON p.RECORD_ITEM_ID=i.RECORD_ITEM_ID WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE='LOCATION' AND i.DELETED_YN='N' AND NVL(p.PRIMARY_YN,'N')='Y'
mapper.sql: i.RECORD_ITEM_ID,i.RECORD_TARGET_ID,i.RECORD_TYPE,i.CONTENT_ID, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='NOTE' THEN NVL(n.NOTE_TITLE,i.TITLE) WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='FILE' THEN NVL(f.ORIGINAL_NAME,i.TITLE) WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' THEN NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(pp.DESCRIPTION),''),i.TITLE) ELSE i.TITLE END AS TITLE,i.SORT_ORDER, i.CREATED_BY,i.CREATED_AT,i.UPDATED_AT,i.DELETED_YN, n.USER_ID AS NOTE_USER_ID,nu.USER_NAME,n.REG_DT,n.UPDATED_BY,uu.USER_NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME,n.UPD_DT, n.MEMO AS PREVIEW_CONTENT, l.LINK_URL,l.LINK_TITLE,l.DESCRIPTION, p.LOCATION_TEXT,p.LOCATION_ADDRESS,p.LOCATION_LAT,p.LOCATION_LNG,p.LOCATION_PLACE_ID,p.MEMO AS LOCATION_MEMO,p.DESCRIPTION AS LOCATION_DESCRIPTION,NVL(p.PRIMARY_YN,'N') AS PRIMARY_YN, f.ORIGINAL_NAME AS FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME,f.MIME_TYPE AS FILE_CONTENT_TYPE,f.FILE_EXT AS FILE_EXTENSION,f.FILE_SIZE, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/files/'||f.CONTENT_FILE_ID||'/download' END AS FILE_DOWNLOAD_URL, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='FILE' AND f.CREATED_BY=#{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FILE_CAN_RENAME, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' THEN ( SELECT '/photo/media/' || TO_CHAR(MIN(ph.PHOTO_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY NVL(ph.SORT_ORDER,0), ph.PHOTO_ID)) FROM PHOTOS ph WHERE ph.POST_ID=i.CONTENT_ID ) END AS THUMBNAIL_URL, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' THEN ppu.USER_NAME WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='FILE' THEN fu.USER_NAME ELSE iu.USER_NAME END AS CREATOR_NAME, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PHOTOS phc WHERE phc.POST_ID=i.CONTENT_ID ) ELSE 0 END AS PHOTO_COUNT, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS cr WHERE cr.CONTENT_TYPE='PHOTO_POST' AND cr.CONTENT_ID=i.CONTENT_ID AND cr.REACTION_TYPE='LIKE' ) ELSE 0 END AS LIKE_COUNT, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PHOTO_POST_COMMENTS pc WHERE pc.POST_ID=i.CONTENT_ID AND NVL(pc.DELETED_YN,'N')='N' ) ELSE 0 END AS COMMENT_COUNT, CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' AND #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS cr WHERE cr.CONTENT_TYPE='PHOTO_POST' AND cr.CONTENT_ID=i.CONTENT_ID AND cr.USER_ID=#{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND cr.REACTION_TYPE='LIKE' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LIKED_BY_ME

LEFT JOIN NOTES n ON i.RECORD_TYPE='NOTE' AND n.NOTE_ID=i.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN USERS nu ON nu.USER_ID=n.USER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS uu ON uu.USER_ID=n.UPDATED_BY LEFT JOIN CONTENT_RECORD_LINKS l ON l.RECORD_ITEM_ID=i.RECORD_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN CONTENT_RECORD_LOCATIONS p ON p.RECORD_ITEM_ID=i.RECORD_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN CONTENT_FILES f ON i.RECORD_TYPE='FILE' AND f.CONTENT_FILE_ID=i.CONTENT_ID AND f.DELETED_YN='N' LEFT JOIN USERS fu ON fu.USER_ID=f.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN PHOTO_POSTS pp ON i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' AND pp.POST_ID=i.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN USERS ppu ON ppu.USER_ID=pp.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN USERS iu ON iu.USER_ID=i.CREATED_BY

SELECT FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i
WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.DELETED_YN='N' ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.RECORD_TYPE='LOCATION' AND NVL(p.PRIMARY_YN,'N')='Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,i.SORT_ORDER,i.RECORD_ITEM_ID

SELECT FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i
WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND i.DELETED_YN='N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_TYPE=#{recordType} AND DELETED_YN='N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i JOIN CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t ON t.RECORD_TARGET_ID=i.RECORD_TARGET_ID WHERE i.RECORD_TYPE=#{recordType} AND i.CONTENT_ID=#{contentId} AND NVL(i.DELETED_YN,'N')='N' AND NVL(t.TARGET_STATUS,'ACTIVE')='ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i WHERE i.RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE pp.POST_ID=i.CONTENT_ID AND NVL(pp.DELETED_YN,'N')='Y' AND pp.DELETED_AT IS NOT NULL AND pp.DELETED_AT + 30 <= SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET DELETED_YN='Y',UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND CREATED_BY=#{userId} AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET DELETED_YN='Y',UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_ITEM_ID=#{recordItemId} AND RECORD_TYPE='PHOTO' AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET DELETED_YN='Y',UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND RECORD_TYPE=#{recordType} AND DELETED_YN='N'
UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS SET DELETED_YN = #{deletedYn}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE RECORD_TYPE = 'PHOTO' AND CONTENT_ID = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM ( SELECT f.FOLDER_ID FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i JOIN CONTENT_FILES f ON f.CONTENT_FILE_ID=i.CONTENT_ID WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE='FILE' AND f.FOLDER_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.DELETED_YN='N' AND f.DELETED_YN='N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.RECORD_ITEM_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM=1
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_FILES f SET f.FOLDER_ID=#{folderId}, f.UPDATED_BY=#{userId}, f.UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE f.CONTENT_FILE_ID IN ( SELECT i.CONTENT_ID FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE='FILE' AND i.DELETED_YN='N' ) AND f.DELETED_YN='N' AND NVL(f.FOLDER_ID,-1)<>NVL(#{folderId},-1)
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(f.FILE_SIZE), 0) FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i JOIN CONTENT_FILES f ON f.CONTENT_FILE_ID = i.CONTENT_ID AND f.DELETED_YN = 'N' WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID = #{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE = 'FILE' AND i.DELETED_YN = 'N'

SELECT NVL(SUM(p.FILE_SIZE), 0) FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS i JOIN PHOTO_POSTS pp ON pp.POST_ID = i.CONTENT_ID JOIN PHOTOS p ON p.POST_ID = pp.POST_ID WHERE i.RECORD_TARGET_ID = #{recordTargetId} AND i.RECORD_TYPE = 'PHOTO' AND i.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND NVL(pp.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N'
